summary: Backup generators may operate only 9am-5pm weekdays excluding holidays, unless supplying power during an outage. Public website plus 24-hour notice for routine runs.
text: Unless the generators are supplying backup electrical supply during a power outage, backup generators may operate between the hours of 9:00 am and 5:00 pm, Monday through Friday, excluding holidays.
notes: Secondary sources describe this as a testing protocol. It is an operating-hours restriction.
